_about: The busy page's words (apps/busy-worker, README 'Words'). English is the source; every other language is a machine draft, shown with its 'machine' label until a person checks it. Keys: heading (also the tab title), body (says the visitor is being taken to beanpool.org), go (the link to beanpool.org's page in their language), retry (the smaller link that asks global again), apps (members' apps keep working), machine (the draft's label; absent in English). Plain, calm words; never the two words the project bans (scripts/words/GLOSSARY.csv).
